name: Car Lyrics
subtitle: Synced lyrics on CarPlay via Live Activities.
description: A SideStore source for Car Lyrics. New unsigned builds are published automatically from the main branch.

apps.name: Car Lyrics
apps.subtitle: Time-synced lyrics on CarPlay and the lock screen.
apps.localizedDescription: Detects the song playing on your iPhone (Apple Music or Spotify) and shows time-synced lyrics on the CarPlay widgets screen and the lock screen via a Live Activity. No CarPlay entitlement is required.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Car Lyrics reads what's playing in the Music app to show synced lyrics.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used only if you enable Shazam-style recognition for other apps.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Keeps Car Lyrics running so lyrics keep advancing on CarPlay and the lock screen. Your location isn't recorded or shared.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Keeps Car Lyrics running in the background so lyrics keep advancing on CarPlay and the lock screen. Your location isn't recorded or shared.
